description: Get a Detailed Facility Report for one facility by its EPA Registry ID: name, address, permits held, and per-statute (CAA/CWA/RCRA/SDWA) compliance and inspection summaries. Use epa_facility_search first to obtain the registry_id.

registry_id.description: EPA Registry ID (FRS ID), the numeric facility identifier returned by epa_facility_search (e.g. '110001136271').

name: epa_facility_details
